declarations.coverage: Drafted from the repository tree by `discovery/draft-documentation-scope.mjs`: every file Git keeps under the documentation root `docs`, a new index for each of its directories without one, the development guide, and the domain glossaries and context maps the rules identify. Paths other declarations own are left out, and so is each README.md outside the documentation roots. Link-repair files and move destinations enter when the work needs them. The Markdown files under acceptance, examples, and skills that the draft asked about are excluded: they are acceptance fixtures, packaged author examples, and packaged system skills, which are product or test material rather than repository documentation, and none moves. docs is the only documentation root; no other directory is one.

declarations.coverage: This declaration changes only remote GitHub configuration for the unambiguous github.com remote lutzseverino/repo-standards through its authored operations. The empty project-content scope is intentional. The maintainer authorizes this adoption, including its remote operations, by confirming the complete inspection; no repository identity question is open.

Repository Standards is one maintained root TypeScript and Node.js CLI package. package.json owns the build, CLI, bootstrap, system skills, packaging, tests and release commands, and pnpm-workspace.yaml declares no member packages, so no directory is a separately maintained Project with its own responsibility and development commands. The root README belongs to the repository README declaration. The explained empty scope is complete.
